main_post_requirements: The completed 22 September Korean session was split: KOSPI 7017.91 +0.15% after a +2.20% opening, KOSDAQ 834.38 -0.23%. A broad rally claim is false; distinguish Samsung +0.91% from Hynix -1.50% and visible sector/flow divergence.
USD/KRW 15:30 reference 1358.2 fell 22.8 won, while domestic sovereign 3y fell 1.6bp and 10y rose 0.4bp. Different assets did not share one direction; source explanations are not causal proof.

Current US-Iran headline is a conditional seven-day reopening proposal, not an implemented agreement. Oil first fell in the previous US session but rebounded intraday on 22 September; identify observation times and opposing supply risk.

BOK says household-debt/GDP ratio may decline mostly because nominal GDP grows. Do not portray household repayment relief as realized; state current corporate debt stress and the prospective bank-capital benefit from KRW strengthening.
Uber's Delivery Hero/Baemin transaction has only begun Korean pre-review; outline the competition/advertising/member-data mechanism and approval condition, not a completed acquisition.
Upcoming US data and US-China talks need source-supported times or time-unconfirmed labels. Holiday gap prevents a Korean close for 24 September; do not reuse 22 September values as later closes.
